action.objective: Broad search all legal moves at depth 4 to find the strongest plan keeping the extra piece.
action.rationale: White has an extra piece (Black lost a bishop for two pawns). Broad search must cover all roots before selecting a candidate. No castling available; king on e1 is exposed along the d-file, so the rook on d1 and bishop activity matter. Use the full broad-search allowance.
